title: SError
description:
SError is an XDR Struct defined as:

```text struct Error { ErrorCode code; string msg<100>; }; ```

msg.description: Byte string, not UTF-8, of at most 100 bytes, escaped per SEP-51: printable ASCII (0x20-0x7e) is unchanged, except backslash as \\; NUL, tab, LF and CR as \0, \t, \n and \r; any other byte as \xNN. The escaped string may be longer than 100 characters.

ErrorCode.description:
ErrorCode is an XDR Enum defined as:

```text enum ErrorCode { ERR_MISC = 0, // Unspecific error ERR_DATA = 1, // Malformed data ERR_CONF = 2, // Misconfiguration error ERR_AUTH = 3, // Authentication failure ERR_LOAD = 4  // System overloaded }; ```
